name: Teaching Yourself Reading Comprehension
instructions: Explain what you just read to an imaginary listener (or actually out loud) -- gaps in your explanation reveal gaps in understanding.
Reread only the specific passage that confused you, not the whole section, once you have identified where clarity broke down.
Keep a running list of unfamiliar words or references and look them up in a batch rather than stopping constantly.
Watch today's video for more comprehension-teaching techniques.
